name: Al Khabeer
description: Allah is fully aware of the realities of all things; no hidden detail escapes Him.
summary: Al Khabeer describes Allah's complete awareness of the realities of things. The Arabic root is kh-b-r (خ ب ر), relating to knowledge and awareness, not k-b-r, the root associated with greatness. Nothing hidden in creation or in human actions escapes Him.
